info.title: HIKOYA PRO API
info.description: Telegram Mini App + boshqaruv boti uchun API. Barcha endpointlar /api/v1 ostida.

post.description: Validate raw initData on the server (initDataUnsafe is never trusted) and open a session.
Local development only. Disabled unless HIKOYA_DEV_AUTH_ENABLED=true (refused in production).

get.description: Personal data export (spec 29). Only the user's own records.

post.description: Account deletion is a reviewed request: financial records follow the retention policy.

get.description: Full text only for entitled users; otherwise the free preview blocks + offers (never the full body).
Continue, saved, reading, finished, purchased, quotes & notes, personal collections.

Optional reading rhythm (spec 23.10): last 7 days of active minutes, goal and streak.

Private to the user; not connected to money, TOP or forced messages.
Explicit user action to open a spoiler. Paid chapter discussion still needs access.

post.description: Sell one work separately (PURCHASE / PREMIUM_OR_PURCHASE). Creates or re-prices its product.

get.description: Editor payload: the head (draft or published) revision with its id, for base_revision on save.

post.description: Autosave/save. A stale base_revision_id returns 409 with the current head (client keeps its text).

get.description: Authorised preview (draft included). Never counted in statistics (T-26).
Aggregated per-work statistics for its author. No individual reader data (spec 21).
T-58: export of the author's own aggregated numbers only (no reader ids, notes or purchases).
Short-lived signed link (default TTL 60 s). The token is not logged.
startapp parameter → target. A link never grants access by itself.
